verses.tl: Wa ammaa aadun fa-uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin aatiyah
Sakhkharahaa alayhim sab'a layaalin wa thamaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral-qawma feehaa sar'aa ka'annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah
Wa jaa'a fir'awnu wa man qablahu wal-mu'tafikaatu bil-khaati'ah
Fa-asaw rasoola rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akhdhatan raabiyah
Linaj'alahaa lakum tadhkiratan wa ta'iyahaa udhunun waa'iyah
Wa humilatil-ardu wal-jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatan waahidah
Wal-malaku alaa arjaa'ihaa wa yahmilu arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma'idhin thamaaniyah
Yawma'idhin tu'radoona laa takhfaa minkum khaafiyah
Fa-ammaa man ootiya kitaabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haa'uum iqra'oo kitaabee
Kuloo washraboo hanee'an bimaa aslaftum fil-ayyaamil-khaaliyah
Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahu bishimaalihi fayaqoolu yaa laytanee lam oota kitaabeeh
Thumma fee silsilatin dhar'uhaa sab'oona dhiraa'an faslukooh
Wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen
Wa maa huwa biqawli shaa'irin qaleelan maa tu'minoon
Wa laa biqawli kaahinin qaleelan maa tadhakkaroon
Famaa minkum min ahadin anhu haajizeen
Wa innaa lana'lamu anna minkum mukadhdhibeen
